svg.title: Transparency: The Label on the Medicine
svg.desc: An AI system, such as a chatbot or a screening tool, shows four things people can see or read: an AI disclosure such as "You're chatting with AI"; stated limitations, what it can get wrong; sources for answers, such as citations and links to the policy behind each answer; and documented intended uses and limits, such as Microsoft's transparency notes. Together they produce an informed user who knows it's AI, its limits and where answers came from. Without them, users trust answers they should have checked.
svg.text: Transparency: The Label on the Medicine
Things people can see or read let them judge when to trust an answer and when to check it.
Citations, links to the policy behind
